risk_score_note: The XGBoost output is used for relative ranking and must not be displayed as a calibrated probability.
measurement_support_note: Measurement support is based on the number of Ookla tests contributing to the cell-quarter measurement. It is a relative evidence indicator, not an accuracy guarantee.
explanation_note: SHAP contributors explain model behaviour and must not be described as proven causes of degradation.

time_machine_categories.correctly_anticipated: Top-200 flagged cell that actually became underperforming
time_machine_categories.false_alert: Top-200 flagged cell that did not become underperforming
time_machine_categories.missed: Lower-risk cell that later became underperforming
time_machine_categories.correctly_lower_risk: Lower-risk cell that remained outside the underperforming group

task: Among currently normal cells, rank which cells are most likely to fall into the bottom 25% of Klang Valley download performance next quarter.
score_interpretation: Model output is an emerging-risk ranking score. It is not presented as a calibrated probability.
